events.name: Prince Edward County Gravity Fest
events.place: Pitt Street hill (York, Pitt and Church streets), Picton
events.organiser: Kolby Parks and the Parks family (PEC Gravity Fest Committee); IGSA-sanctioned (2010 Canadian championships; IGSA NorAm Downhill Series)
events.about: A 1.2 km straw-baled run down the Pitt Street hill in the middle of Picton, with a famous 'Crash Corner' at Pitt and York. Street luger Kolby Parks brought it home to the County in 2010 as the first IGSA-sanctioned race in Ontario, and it ran as a NorAm stop in 2011 and 2012.

events.name: Maryhill Festival of Speed / Tour de Maryhill
events.organiser: International Downhill Federation (2013 Festival of Speed); Maryhill Ratz (Tour de Maryhill, IDF WQS in 2019)
events.about: The hairpins of the Maryhill Loops Road above the Columbia River Gorge are one of the best-known closed-road downhill courses in North America. It has hosted IDF World Cup racing as the Maryhill Festival of Speed and, more recently, the Maryhill Ratz' Tour de Maryhill, a race, skate school and campout that also served as a qualifier for the 2024 World Skate Games.

events.name: Killington Downhill World Cup
events.place: Killington (course with Tetanus Corner, Bridge Left and the Super Straight)
events.about: An IDF World Cup on a steep, rough mountain road at Killington, part of the North American summer tour. Its track records list 2017 and 2018 times, and the 2019 edition was a full World Cup stop.

events.name: Gravity Fest (Munnsville)
events.about: A World Qualifying Series race in the hills of central New York that opened the 2019 IDF North American tour a fortnight before Killington. The 2019 race was run in the rain and Canadian riders took three of the four classes.

events.name: L'Ultime Descente
events.about: A gravity speed trial on the steep hillside road at Les Éboulements in Charlevoix, open to street luges, longboards and gravity cars. In 2016 about 120 riders took part, and Mike McIntyre set a street luge world record of 164.12 km/h there.

events.name: World Downhill Skateboarding Championship: Utah
events.place: Upper road at Utah Olympic Park (about 1.6 km, four hairpins, 7.7% average grade)
events.organiser: World Downhill Skateboarding Championship (WDSC); race director Justin Rolo
events.about: Round four of the 2025 WDSC world tour, raced on one of the highest roads at Utah Olympic Park with a chairlift back to the top. It ran an amateur QS race and a professional CT race over the last weekend of September 2025.

events.name: Whistler Longboard Festival
events.about: A longboard festival in Whistler whose race day counted as an IDF World Cup. In 2016 Canadians swept the open podium and Kolby Parks won the luge.

events.name: Attack of Danger Bay
events.place: Pender Harbour roads, with an 8 km push race in Egmont that finishes in the ocean
events.about: Billed as Canada's largest downhill skateboard race, held over the May long weekend in Pender Harbour on the Sunshine Coast. Alongside the race it runs freeride, a slide contest, skate hockey and an ocean big-air finish, and has reached its 22nd edition.

events.name: Devil's Peak Downhill
events.organiser: Justin Rolo and Venom Skate Products
events.about: A Rocky Mountain downhill race on the Guanella Pass road above Georgetown. The second edition, in August 2018, was won by Canada's Dane Hanna.

events.name: WinSport Canada Cup
events.about: An IGSA World Cup downhill skateboard race in Calgary. In September 2011 it gave Patrick Switzer his fourth World Cup win in a row on the way to the season title.

events.name: Whitcomb Summit Downhill
events.place: Whitcomb Hill Road, near the high point of Route 2
events.about: A first-time downhill race on Whitcomb Hill Road in the Berkshires, near the highest point of the Mohawk Trail (Route 2). Riders came from as far as Spain, Australia and Mexico in 2019.

events.name: IGSA California Championship (Bonelli Park)
events.organiser: International Gravity Sports Association (IGSA California Downhill Series)
events.about: Southern California's IGSA series raced the Via Verde course at Bonelli Park, with stand-up, street luge and classic luge classes. It hosted the 2006 series finale and the fourth of five 2007 races.

events.name: Salt Spring Slasher
events.about: A downhill longboard event on Salt Spring Island organised by local street luger Max Kaye. Its 13th annual edition ran on 24-25 August 2024.

events.name: Crankworx Whistler
events.about: The biggest week of the Crankworx World Tour, held in the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, with Red Bull Joyride slopestyle, dual slalom, a pump track challenge and downhill. The 2025 edition was the festival's 20th.

events.name: Sea Otter Classic Dual Slalom
events.about: The dual slalom at the Sea Otter Classic bike festival at Laguna Seca, which bills itself as the 'world championship of dual slalom'. Riders race side by side on twin courses in a knockout format.

events.name: Red Bull Guanajuato Cerro Abajo
events.place: Alleys and staircases of central Guanajuato, finishing at the Alhóndiga de Granaditas
events.organiser: Red Bull (Red Bull Cerro Abajo series)
events.about: An urban downhill mountain bike race of about 1.6 km through the historic lanes and stairways of Guanajuato, ending on the esplanade of the Alhóndiga de Granaditas. It is a round of the Red Bull Cerro Abajo series; coordinates are the finish.

events.name: Downhill Taxco (Taxco Urban Downhill)
events.place: Streets and stairways of Taxco (about 1,800 m, 300 m drop)
events.about: An urban downhill race down the narrow streets and steep stairs of the silver town of Taxco, the finale of the Urban Downhill series in 2016. The 2017 sixth edition was 1,800 m long with about 300 m of drop.

events.name: UCI Pump Track World Championships qualifier (Langford)
events.organiser: Red Bull UCI Pump Track World Championships (Velosolutions)
events.about: The 2022 Canadian qualifier for the pump track world championships, raced on the asphalt pump track at Jordie Lunn Bike Park. Winners earned a start at the world final.

events.name: UCI Pump Track World Championships qualifier (Sicamous)
events.organiser: Velosolutions UCI Pump Track World Championships
events.about: Canada's pump track world championship qualifier since 2024, held on the Finlayson Park track in Sicamous. The 2025 qualifier was set for 7 June.

events.name: UCI Pump Track World Championships qualifier (Sugar Land)
events.organiser: Velosolutions UCI Pump Track World Championships
events.about: A US qualifier for the pump track world championships on the Velosolutions track at Crown Festival Park. The 2025 race was the second in a row held there.

events.name: UCI Pump Track World Championships qualifier (Erie)
events.organiser: Velosolutions UCI Pump Track World Championships
events.about: Colorado's pump track world championship qualifier, held on the Revolution Pump Track in Erie a week after the Sugar Land race. It was one of three US qualifiers in 2025.

events.name: USA BMX SC Gold Cup Finals (Pro Series)
events.about: USA BMX's pro racing weekend at the Gold Cup Finals, run on the Hardesty National BMX Stadium track in Tulsa. Pros raced on both Friday and Saturday in September 2025.

events.name: USA Cycling BMX National Championships (Elite)
events.organiser: USA Cycling, raced within the USA BMX Legacy Nationals
events.about: The national title races for elite, U23 and junior BMX riders, held in May 2025 as part of USA BMX's Legacy Nationals at Hardesty. Winners wear the stars-and-stripes jersey for the year.

events.name: USA BMX Race of Champions & Grand Nationals
events.about: The season-ending 'Grands' over the US Thanksgiving weekend in Tulsa, where USA BMX crowns its national No. 1 riders. The 2024 edition was raced indoors in the Expo Square building.

events.name: Toronto 2015 Pan American Games BMX
events.place: Centennial Park Pan Am BMX Centre
events.about: The BMX racing events of the 2015 Pan Am Games were held on the purpose-built track in Etobicoke's Centennial Park on 10-11 July 2015. Canada's Tory Nyhaug won the men's race on home soil.

events.name: Dew Tour Des Moines
events.about: Dew Tour brought its park and street contests to the new Lauridsen Skatepark on the Des Moines riverfront in May 2021, weeks after the park opened and shortly before the Tokyo Olympics. It returned for a second year in July 2022.

events.name: Tampa Pro
events.about: Skateboarding's longest-running pro street contest, held every spring at Skatepark of Tampa on a street course rebuilt each year. The first winner, in 1995, was Mike Vallely; the 32nd edition ran in April 2026.

events.name: Exposure
events.place: Poods Encinitas Skate Park (2025 and 2026 editions)
events.about: Billed as the world's largest women's skateboarding contest, Exposure has been held in Encinitas every year since the early 2010s, with bowl, vert and street divisions from amateurs to pros and over-40s. The 2024 edition was its 13th consecutive year.

events.name: Kona Classic
events.about: A freestyle (flatland) skateboarding contest at Kona Skatepark, with amateur, masters and pro classes. The 2025 edition ran 10-12 January.

events.name: Vans Pool Party
events.about: A pool contest in the Combi Bowl at the Vans skatepark in Orange, with pro, masters and legends divisions. 2019 was billed as the 15th and final Pool Party at the Combi, but Thrasher covered another 'final' edition in 2025.

events.name: X Games Ventura 2024
events.about: The 2024 summer X Games in Ventura ran skateboard street, park and vert alongside BMX. Only partial skateboard podiums are given here.

events.name: Nitro World Games
events.about: Nitro Circus's action-sports games began in July 2016 with big-ramp best-trick contests built inside the University of Utah's Rice-Eccles Stadium. Later editions moved to other Utah venues and abroad.

events.name: Primer Abierto de Skate del Parque La Ruina
events.about: The first open bowl contest at Parque La Ruina in Hermosillo, on 19-20 April 2024, with men's and women's divisions and riders from Mexico City, Guadalajara, Tijuana and Aguascalientes. Only qualifying scores were found, so no podium is listed.

events.name: Veteranos Mexico Skate Jam
events.about: A bowl jam for veteran skaters at the Rabioso Bowl in Mexico City; the fourth edition ran on 16 December 2018. Bowl location within the city not confirmed, so coordinates are the city centre.

events.name: NorthShore Inline Marathon
events.place: Highway 61 along Lake Superior, Two Harbors to Duluth (point to point)
events.about: A point-to-point inline skating marathon on the Lake Superior shore road from Two Harbors into Duluth, held every September since 1996. It draws elite speed skaters from Colombia and Europe; both course records fell in 2025. Coordinates are the start town.

events.name: Bitter Cold Showdown
events.about: A winter rollerblading contest and industry trade show that started in Indiana in 2001 and settled at Modern Skate Park in Royal Oak in 2009. After a last edition in February 2013 it came back for an encore in 2023, and a 'BroDown' followed in 2025.

events.name: The Blading Cup
events.about: The Blading Cup is a long-running annual aggressive inline contest in Southern California, usually held in autumn, with pro, women's ('Bladies'), open, under-18 and veterans divisions; the 2019 edition drew 160 skaters from 26 countries. Recent editions were held in Santa Ana; the 2024 pro final was rained out.

events.name: Windy City Riot
events.place: Chicago street spots (2012 park day at Logan Square / Logan Boulevard Skate Park)
events.organiser: Collin Martin (since 2004); founded by Travis Conn and Jess Thompson
events.about: A blader-run 'real street' rollerblading contest held at spots around Chicago, which marked its 20th anniversary in 2021. The 2012 edition added a park day at the Logan Square skatepark and a street day on the lakefront 'Slabs'.

events.name: DC Live Street Contest
events.about: A live street rollerblading contest held at spots around the US capital. The 2025 edition was filmed and released by ButterTV as 'Federal Cases'.

events.name: Metro Card Classic
events.place: New York street spots, including the Brooklyn Banks
events.about: A street rollerblading contest across New York City spots, including the Brooklyn Banks. The 2025 edition ran 4-7 September.

events.name: Carriers Open (U.S. Roller Freestyle Championships)
events.place: Frisco Skate Park, 12895 Honey Grove Dr.
events.organiser: Play Frisco; hosted by Arlo Eisenberg
events.about: A city-run skate park contest for bladers that served as the 2025 U.S. Roller Freestyle Championships, with open, women's ('Bladies') and kids categories. The 2025 edition was on 8 November; no results were published on the page found.

events.name: Canadian Freestyle Scooter Series: BC Open
events.about: Described as the first Canadian freestyle scooter competition, the BC Open ran on 4 July 2026 with two 45-second judged runs per rider from beginner to pro. It is part of a national series that also lists an Alberta Open in Calgary; no results were found.
